name: Browser key
description: Sends keyboard keys or shortcuts in the visible in-app browser, optionally focusing a target element first.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 在用户眼前可见的内嵌浏览器中发送按键或组合键（Tab/Enter/Escape 等），可先按 CSS 选择器聚焦目标；与文本输入 browser_type 分开。
localizedDescription.en-US: Sends keyboard keys or shortcuts (Tab/Enter/Escape, modifiers) in the visible in-app browser. Optionally focus a CSS selector first. Distinct from browser_type text insertion.

keys.description: Ordered key names, e.g. ["Tab"], ["Enter"], ["Meta+K"]. Whitelist only.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to focus before sending keys. Supports frame:N prefix.
